# GitHub Copilot Instructions

You are an AI assistant helping to build a personal academic website for a researcher in AI4Med and Single-Cell Omics.

## Key Preferences
- **Design**: "Nature Blue" style. Use CSS variables `--primary-color` and `--accent-color`.
- **Code Style**: Clean HTML5, BEM-style CSS classes.
- **Frameworks**: None. Pure HTML/CSS/JS.

## Project Structure
- The website files are in `public/`.
- `public/index.html` is the homepage.
- `public/css/style.css` contains ALL styles.

## Specific Tasks
- **When writing HTML**: Ensure accessibility (alt tags, aria-labels).
- **When writing Content**: Focus on "Plastic Surgery", "Regenerative Medicine", and "Single-Cell Sequencing".
- **When suggesting images**: Use placeholders like `assets/placeholder.jpg` if the real image isn't known.

## Navigation Warning
- The navigation bar is static HTML duplicated across pages. If editing the header, check if it needs to be synced.
